patch.value: Install the pinned release npm into a job-local prefix

The release workflow replaces the runner's global npm with the pinned npm. Parallel jobs on one runner host share the toolcache Node installation, so one job's global install mutates a sibling job's npm mid-install (ENOTEMPTY, or npm: command not found). Tracked by unbraind/pm-ops#284.

The release workflow installs the pinned npm with --prefix into a job-local directory and prepends that prefix bin to the job path; The workflow keeps the exact-version assertion on the effective npm; A workflow-contract test fails if any workflow replaces the global npm; Gates pass: typecheck, lint, tests, changelog:check
